author: OfficialPixelMC
body: I was banned on the 7th February 2012, at 8:00:32 AM GMT by Pelpelajax - reason hacking - Kill aura. I had been reported by a user (unknown) and was banned whilst offline. The user told me he had reported me ,while playing online, for hacking, as I killed him whilst he was wearing diamond armour. There is no evidence that I was not hacking, however, there was also no evidence I was hacking. This accusation is obsured, I had been playing Nebula on The Avicus Network and was banned after I disconnected after playing a game. This is the reason for why I should be unbanned.

title: OfficialPixelMC - Ban Appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal your ban.

This is your 1st and only warning. Get banned for hacking again you'll stay banned.

Please read the Here before re-joining the server
